item_text: Explain prediction versus inference and choose an appropriate modeling objective.
Reason about model flexibility, training error, test error, overfitting, and the bias-variance trade-off.
Formulate simple and multiple linear regression and interpret coefficients.
Assess regression fit and uncertainty using residual error, R-squared, confidence intervals, and hypothesis tests.
Recognize important assumptions, interactions, nonlinear terms, and common limitations of linear regression.
Judge whether the complete graph is adequate for the declared aspect and representative tasks.
